episodes.text: The pink unicorn skipped through the meadow and met a kind, curious little bee.
The bee showed the unicorn a secret garden full of glowing flowers.
In the garden they found a tiny baby dragon who was lost and afraid.
The unicorn and the bee decided to help the dragon find its way home.
They travelled through the whispering woods where the trees could talk.
A wise old owl told them the way to the dragon mountain.
They crossed a sparkling stream and climbed a hill of soft purple moss.
At the top of the hill they saw the dragon mountain in the distance.
The baby dragon recognised its home and flapped its tiny wings with joy.
The mother dragon flew down to meet them and thanked them with a warm smile.
She gave the unicorn a magical flower that would never stop glowing.
The unicorn and the bee said goodbye to their new dragon friends.
On the way home they met a rabbit who told them about another adventure.
The unicorn smiled and knew there would always be more adventures to come.
